_metadata.description: The output surface registry: declared pixel geometry, permitted placements, the external authority each geometry derives from, and the conformance gate that keeps a produced asset matching the target it claims.

requirements.title: The system shall persist an output surface as a record declaring its pixel geometry
requirements.description: The system shall persist each output surface as a record carrying its identifier, its **kind**, its exact pixel width and height, its permitted placements, and a reference to the published requirement its geometry derives from. The kind is load-bearing rather than descriptive: it is the only input that selects mockup chrome fidelity (`UIX-008`, `UIX-009`). A surface geometry that a store mandates changes without notice, so the system shall hold it as data with a cited source rather than as a constant in code.

validation.notes: Assert a surface without geometry, without a kind, or without a cited authority is rejected, and that a valid surface round-trips with its placement list intact.

requirements.title: The system shall restrict a render to the placements its surface permits
requirements.description: The system shall refuse a render whose requested placement is not among those its surface declares. A caption-above-device arrangement is meaningful on a phone screenshot surface and meaningless on a feature graphic, and the surface record is where that constraint lives.

validation.notes: Assert a permitted template composes and an unpermitted one is refused with both the surface and the template named.

requirements.title: The system shall refuse to release a backdrop whose dimensions do not match its declared surface
requirements.description: The system shall compare a produced candidate's actual pixel dimensions against its declared surface geometry and shall refuse release on any mismatch, stating the expected and the actual. A store rejects a listing asset of the wrong size, so this is caught before submission rather than after.

validation.notes: Produce a candidate one pixel off in each dimension; assert release refuses and names both geometries. Assert an exact match releases.

requirements.title: The system should ship the app-store surfaces as declared records
requirements.description: The system should seed the store surfaces as records — Play feature graphic, Play phone and tablet screenshots, and App Store screenshots at each required device class — each carrying the geometry its store mandates and a reference to the published requirement. The system should treat these as data subject to change rather than as fixed knowledge, and should surface the date each was last confirmed.

validation.notes: Assert every seeded store surface carries geometry, a cited authority, and a confirmation date, and that the pack loads without a code change.
